data.name: Sharita
data.gender_notes: Sharita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri', which means 'goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity'. The suffix 'ita' means 'that which is'. Thus, Sharita can be interpreted as 'the goddess of love and beauty'. The name Sharita carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharita is a divine name that represents the embodiment of love, beauty, and grace. It is believed to bring happiness, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer.
data.etymology: Sharita belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Beauty.”
